body:
Founder real-time ask this session: replace grep/sed/awk with PARENA-native versions. Investigated live: stdlib/grep.prn+sed.prn+awk.prn+regex/* already have real, parena-parse-verified .prn source (STDLIB.md tiers 16-18), but parena build failed immediately on the first dependency with a real compiler gap -- self-referencing defenum/defstruct types unsupported (found via regex/syntax.prn's own recursive PatternNode AST type). Fixed: process_defenum/process_defstruct now register a type's own name before resolving its own field types, not after -- unblocks any recursive struct/enum anywhere in the stdlib, not just this one. Also fixed a related box-helper C-declaration spacing bug and reconciled a concurrent obs-watcher-dispatched AGI-loop session's own in-flight work (scarab.prn test-registration redesign) that landed in the same working tree mid-session. make test: 336/336 passing. Confirmed the real remaining gap for grep/sed/awk: regex/syntax.prn's actual parser body (parse-alt/parse-concat/parse-atom) was never written -- stub signatures only, no ParseState type defined -- a real, substantial, separate follow-up, not a quick fix. Also shipped: vim syntax highlighting for .prn (tools/vim/), a separate founder real-time ask. Commits 63c71e2, 6627c39.

⚓ ☃
title: self-referencing defenum/defstruct fix + box-helper spacing fix + vim syntax highlighting
